question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_rental AS (
    SELECT r.customer_id, r.rental_id, r.rental_date, i.film_id
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE (r.customer_id, r.rental_date) IN (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(rental_date)
        FROM rental
        GROUP BY customer_id
    )
),
first_rental_with_rating AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, fr.film_id, f.rating
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN film f ON fr.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        f.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_amount,
        COUNT(r.rental_id) as total_rentals
    FROM first_rental_with_rating f
    JOIN rental r ON f.customer_id = r.customer_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    frw.rating,
    AVG(cs.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(cs.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rental_with_rating frw
JOIN customer_stats cs ON frw.customer_id = cs.customer_id
GROUP BY frw.rating
ORDER BY frw.rating
